notes.title: Linux OS
notes.content:
[h3][b]The game is now running on Linux.

The employee problems have been fixed. They will no longer be stuck in the same place.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576726/f353fe7e233a1c537bc3f21a7ef14f7f36868ede.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Forklift reset button
notes.content: [b]A button has been added to the warehouse to enable you to return the Forklift to its place in case of an error or the forklift is lost.[/b]

notes.title: Employee Update
notes.content:
[b]The employees have been modified so that they are now coming to work when you enter the game and do not go home until you finish playing[/b]

[i]They were modified at the request of the players[/i]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]The warehouse door has been fixed upon reaching the level of 20, it will be opened permanently[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]When the store is closed, the time will be stopped and when the store is open, it will complete the count time[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The price change is now happening every 10 days[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i][b]Note: There will be an update for the price change system[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: I follow your suggestions
notes.content: [h3][b]I followed your suggestions and comments and fixed some problems such as:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Fix some errors in workers such as stopping and not increasing working time when Boosting[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix the problem of changing the store name[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the problem of changing the price and the number 2 appearing on all empty shelves[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Other minor fixes[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][i][b]Leave your opinion about the game in a comment on the game's page on Steam.[/b][/i][/h3][h3][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3614600"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][/h3][p][b][i]Note: There are upcoming updates for this beautiful game that will be available in the coming periods.[/i][/b][/p]
